title: morrow2026: reproducibility repository for "Scalable simulation of variably saturated groundwater flow: solving the forward problem"
description: Driver scripts, solver-parameter presets, parsed run records, and plotting routines that reproduce every figure and number reported in Morrow, Ghelichkhan and Kramer (2026), "Scalable simulation of variably saturated groundwater flow: solving the forward problem". Covers the verification benchmarks (Tracy, Vauclin, mass conservation) and the parallel-scaling study (Cockett 3D and the Lower Murrumbidgee basin case) built on the G-ADOPT framework and Firedrake.
